title: War of Unification; Memphis founded; Thoth brings writing into Egypt
summary: CFAH AP-22: Thoth/Hermes brings writing into Egypt and the War of Unification founds Memphis, 2164/2163 BC (twentieth year of Menes).
description: CFAH-6 (Argument 2, "Key Synchronisms for Dynasties 3–8") counts "from the Unification of Egypt in the twentieth year of Menes in 2164/2163 BC (Griffith and White 2023a, Anchor Point #22)".

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 3: Anchor Points of Ancient History," ARJ 16 (2023): 131–154, section "AP-22: Hermes/Thoth/Mercury Brings Writing into Egypt: 2164/2163 B.C."; CFAH-6 Argument 2, Table 1 "Anchor Points for early Egyptian history" #22
chronologies.note: CFAH-6 Table 1: "War of Unification, Memphis founded."
Jones (Chart No. 1; Chronology of the Old Testament, 2002) gives no date for this extra-biblical event.
No matching entry found in Ussher's Annals.

chronologies.citation: Preparing the World for Jesus (2nd ed., 2024), ch. 7 "The Return of the Nephilim: Nimrod Attempts World Empire", PDF p. 148 (printed p. 134)
